name: Cloud Forest
mood: A dripping cloud forest at dawn: shafts of emerald sun pierce three layers of giant tree-fern fronds while fireflies drift past a mossy basalt altar holding your coins under a lens of clear rainwater. Open a coin to place it on the wet stone; tap the canopy to shake a shower of dewdrops and scatter the fireflies.
